open.speaker: selasi
open.text: You survived KB. Did he promise you free data bundles yet? He promises everyone free data bundles.

choices.text: He promised me a lucky room.
What are you collecting names for?

lucky.speaker: selasi
lucky.text: KB thinks luck is a policy. I'm Selasi — Economics, Level 300. I'm running against him.

pitch.speaker: selasi
pitch.text: Volunteers. For an SRC that publishes its accounts and answers its emails. Radical, I know. Will you put your name down?

choices.text: Maybe later. I'm still finding the lecture halls.
Why should I trust you more than KB?

yes.speaker: selasi
yes.text: Good. I'll message you. When I say a meeting starts at six, it starts at six.

later.speaker: selasi
later.text: Fair. Find your lecture halls. Then find out who decides what happens in them.

trust.speaker: selasi
trust.text: You shouldn't trust either of us. Check. Ask for the receipts. That's my whole campaign — and it's more than he'll tell you.
